description: One node at a time: host resources, process state, the iroh transport underneath every byte, DHT and probe behaviour, and this node's logs and traces. Host and decdn series share the same instance label, so the node selector drives both.

panels.title: Cache limit against disk
panels.description: cache_size_mb is configured per node and is not checked against the disk behind it. If the limit line ever approaches the filesystem line, the eviction driver is not what will stop the node filling the disk.

panels.title: Peers known
panels.description: Entries in this node's address directory.

panels.title: Telemetry export health
panels.description: A zero here does not prove no traces were lost: the counter wraps the exporter's own export call and does not see batch-queue drops or collector-side partial-success rejections. Those surface as SpanDroppingStarted / SpansDropped at error level under the opentelemetry_sdk target in the log panel below.

panels.title: Bytes sent by path
panels.description: Relay traffic is the expensive path — it means hole punching did not produce a direct route to that peer.

panels.title: Rate-limit rejections
panels.description: Sibling counters rather than one counter with a reason label: a per-IP shed catches one host cycling node IDs, a global shed means the node itself is at its ceiling, and the remedies differ.

panels.title: Rate-limit buckets tracked
panels.description: Bucket counts climbing while the sweep rate stays flat is the memory-exhaustion shape.

panels.title: Events by level
panels.description: From the JSON body. The Loki level stream label is journald priority and reads info for every line this daemon writes, whatever its real severity.

panels.title: Noisiest targets
panels.description: Which Rust module is producing the volume. Dependency crates dominating this list is a log-filter problem, not an application problem.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (tgt) (count_over_time({unit="decdn-node.service", instance=~"$node"} | json tgt="target" [$__auto])))

panels.title: Log bytes shipped
panels.description: What this node costs in Loki ingest.

targets.expr: {unit="decdn-node.service", instance=~"$node"} | json lvl="level", tgt="target", msg="fields.message" | lvl=~"$level" | line_format "{{.lvl}} {{.tgt}} :: {{.msg}}"

panels.title: Span rate by operation
panels.description: Every name here belongs to a dependency crate — iroh, quinn, alloy. deCDN carries no #[instrument] attributes, so the serve leg, pull leg and settlement path produce no spans of their own yet. These panels are built against the operations that will exist.

panels.title: Probe duration
panels.description: The only latency distribution available anywhere in this stack: the exporter registers no histograms, so Prometheus cannot produce a quantile. Exemplars link straight to the trace.

panels.title: Error spans
panels.description: status=error has to sit inside the selector braces; TraceQL has no top-level && between a selector and a condition.

title: deCDN — node drilldown
